result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **I'd recommend Gusto if you want payroll and HR together, or BambooHR if you want a dedicated HR management system.**

The best choice depends on how many employees you have and whether you need payroll, benefits, hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, or simply employee management.

Here are my top recommendations for 2026.

## Best HR software for small companies

![Gusto: The all-in-one people platform for payroll, benefits, HR | Product Hunt](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/U9ihkiZChKRcgqjjRClvDRyT9XG9-GpMyinllUWob9alMftBmPGRcobY-YvDUQKw1cvVb4T3cEeJpN5ErI9IqBVMrrh8CobtTNAx_DYMZG5QgeYUTUHnLdeuUVTXGf9kQQbmuo-8rs3UnMu94W26KU8QJR6ha5lcvmllFK9LSsVoa23KAvlPVkN4pktlksyv?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Gusto**

(Best overall for small businesses)

- Payroll and tax filing
- Employee onboarding
- Benefits administration
- PTO and employee records

**Starting price\:** \$49/month + \$6/employee on the basic plan.

[Gusto website](https://gusto.com/)

---

![Free High-Quality Bamboohr Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NdLSBGjy-t4LAE90fgF-ddR4i37sUJnkP2I2etLyMCzK30ZNnDLeOFNkJ4ONgornqI4dpQO60O7vJzcBWlKGYP0PmgOwkcxyOEu4BL3JtyYZ8ZsdTCrW5IgVGOXAbKINwLVIP8GRxZkWvj639AwhCvO-Z0MW5ibDEnj4uSEouHdZBnZYXe0Ke7Brv94puUyT?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BambooHR**

(Best dedicated HR software)

- Employee database and records
- Hiring and onboarding
- Performance management
- Time-off tracking and reporting

**Starting price\:** Quote-based; published estimates vary by company size.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

(Best for automation)

- HR, payroll, and benefits
- Employee onboarding and offboarding
- IT account and device management
- Automated workflows

**Starting price\:** Approximately \$8/employee/month plus a base fee; modules cost extra.

[Rippling website](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**

(Best budget option)

- Employee records
- Leave management
- Attendance tracking
- Custom HR workflows

**Starting price\:** Around \$1.50/employee/month for entry-level plans.

[Zoho People website](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

---

(Best for payroll support)

- Payroll processing
- Tax administration
- HR support and compliance resources
- Employee self-service

**Starting price\:** Custom quote.

## Quick comparison

| Software | Best use | Payroll |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Gusto | Small business all-in-one | Yes |
| BambooHR | Full HR management | Add-on |
| Rippling | HR automation and IT | Yes, module |
| Zoho People | Affordable HR management | Separate |
| ADP RUN | Payroll and compliance | Yes |


## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down this way\:

- **1–15 employees\:** Gusto or Zoho People.
- **15–50 employees\:** BambooHR or Rippling.
- **50–100 employees\:** BambooHR, Rippling, or ADP.
- **Very limited HR budget\:** Zoho People.

One important distinction: Gusto and ADP are payroll-first platforms, while BambooHR is more focused on managing the employee lifecycle.
